messages:
maya: Heads-up — entering the 24h code freeze window for v1.12.0. If you need a late merge, drop the PR link + short rationale here. We’ll triage quickly.

devon: PR #5123 — runtime: bump serving runtime to 2.4 (required for a dependency update). Waiting on perf tests.

maya: @devon can you summarize risk? perf/regressions? Any migrations?

devon: No schema changes. Risk is potential memory growth under long-lived sessions. Local perf runs show a ~4% mem increase at peak. Latency unchanged.

ryan: tagging infra to run the dedicated perf suite on staging: @jen can you run a quick job?

jen: I’m out for a couple hours but I can kick it off before lunch. If the infra suite passes and e2e is green I can ok a late-merge. Please request explicit /approve-late-merge in this thread after results.

sam: I opened PR #5130 for the changelog and release-notes draft. Will add a callout about the runtime bump and the mitigation plan.

devon: quick cherry-pick instructions for release branch if we get approval:
```
git checkout release/1.12
git fetch origin
git cherry-pick abcdef123456
git push origin release/1.12
```

release-bot: perf-suite/staging triggered by @jen — job id: ps-78421. Canary deployment started.

maya: Great — drop the perf summary here once ps-78421 finishes. We need an explicit decision from release lead. @jordan stepping in?

jordan: I can take it. Two asks: (1) canary in staging must be stable for at least 2 hours, (2) add a rollback play in the PR description (commands + who to call). If both met, +1 for exception.

devon: ps-78421 results: 95th latency: no meaningful change, throughput: same, peak RSS +4%. Canary ran for 2.5 hours, no OOMs. I added rollback steps to PR.

jen: I ran the infra suite and e2e smoke — all green. I’ll /approve-late-merge now.

jen: /approve-late-merge :white_check_mark:

jordan: +1 from me as well after the canary window. :thumbsup:

maya: Approved. @release-bot please tag PR #5123 with late-merge and schedule cherry-pick to release/1.12. Also ensure the changelog PR #5130 is merged.

release-bot: Exception recorded — PR #5123 approved by jordan, jen, maya. Tag applied: late-merge/1.12/5123. Scheduled cherry-pick task created: task-9021.

sam: I’ll merge changelog PR #5130 now and add a short note in the release-notes doc about the memory profile and mitigation steps.

devon: Thanks everyone. I’ll monitor staging and keep a watch on memory over the next 48h after the release cutover.

maya: Thanks team — this thread will be the single point for the exception. If anyone sees a regression after release, call it out here and we’ll follow the rollback plan.

release-bot: Reminder: post-release checklist (automated) will run at +1h and +24h.

maya: Closing the loop — cherry-pick completed and release branch bumped. :tada:
